chunks: 56 - Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhal, Abu al-Hasan. I saw a manuscript which Abu Ja'far ibn Babawayh brought out. He said: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Isḥaq al-Talqani narrated to us, he said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated to us, he said: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhal narrated to us from his father from al-Rida (peace be upon him).

key_terms.ابْنُ بَابَوَيْهَ: Ibn Babawayh, a prominent Shia scholar and compiler of hadith
key_terms.الطَّالِقَانِيُّ: Al-Talqani, a nisba indicating origin from Talqan
key_terms.عَنِ الرِّضَا: From al-Rida, referring to Imam Ali al-Rida (AS)

ai.seo_question: Who is Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhal and what is his narrational chain in Shia sources?
ai.summary: This entry provides the biographical and transmission context for Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhal, noting that the author (Ibn Babawayh) saw a manuscript of his work. It outlines the chain of narrators linking Ali ibn Fadhal to his father and then to Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him).
